title: Correct molar heat capacity formula
description: Essential: Student must derive or state C = 4R (or equivalent expression) for the given process.

title: Correct numerical heat capacity value
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the numerical value, approximately 33.2 J/(mol·K), with proper units.

title: Correct oscillation frequency formula
description: Essential: Student must derive or state ω = sqrt(8σ/(ρ h r²)) for the small radial oscillations.

title: Correct numerical frequency value
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute ω ≈ 108 s⁻¹, with proper units.

title: Application of Laplace pressure
description: Important: Student correctly uses p = 4σ/r (or Δp = 2σ/r applied twice) for the gas pressure inside the bubble.

title: Derivation linking dV/dT
description: Important: Student relates p, V, and T via the equilibrium condition to find dV/dT = 3V/(2T) for part (1).

title: Equation of motion setup
description: Important: For part (2), student applies Newton's second law to a film patch, leading to the restoring force proportional to displacement.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student demonstrates unit analysis for final formulas or numerical answers, confirming dimensional correctness.

title: Misapplication of surface tension pressure
description: Pitfall: Using Δp = 2σ/r instead of p = 4σ/r for the gas pressure inside the bubble (for a double-layer film).

title: Sign error in restoring force
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the equation of motion, failing to show harmonic oscillation (e.g., missing negative sign for force).
